id: title:darkopia:keep my tickets open while a project is pending deletion

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a guard in navigation mode selection to switch to minimal mode when the current project is pending deletion, preventing users from navigating to a project being deleted.
review.reason: Adds a conditional check for `currentProject?.is_pending_deletion` in navigation mode selection, switching to minimal mode if the project is pending deletion. This could prevent navigation links from being shown while a project is pending deletion, potentially avoiding a confusing state where a user could navigate to a project that is being deleted.
